notes.title: R3.0.1 crash fix
notes.content: Fixed a very rare bug that would cause the game to crash to desktop when arriving in Africa. The odds of it happening were about once or twice out of every 100 new games started.

notes.title: R3.0.0 Major update, improvements and fixes
notes.content:
* Unfortunately, due to software idiosyncrasies, this version is not backward compatible with any previous R2 saves.
* Named tribes have now been placed in their correct geographical locations on the map. This is not merely a cosmetic change, it enhances gameplay when playing as an ethnologist and, (to a lesser degree), a journalist. 
   Although misplaced tribes were part of the Avalon Hill version of the board game mechanics (on which the digital version is based), it was too easy to gain victory points by discovering a variety of named tribes which were randomly placed anywhere on the map. The player now has to seek out tribes within their proper locations and may struggle to discover particular tribes if luck and conditions aren't right. 
   E.g. Pygmy tribes inhabit a small area east of Calabar and northeast of the mouth of the Congo and ONLY if the area is jungle. Some of this area is also shared by four other tribes. Therefore, finding Pygmies can now become a challenge. 
* 13 of the 43 Avalon Hill version board game tribal names were either fictitious or misspelt. This has now been fixed.
  1) Tuo is fictitious. Tuo is actually the name of a favourite dish of the Hausa, therefore Tuo tribe are now Hausa.
  2) Wakomba is fictitious, they are now Yakoma.
  3) Bapounon is fictitious, they are now Bamoun.
  4) Bahlya are now Baya.
  5) Bahutu are now Abahutu.
  6) Baluba is fictitious, they are now Abaluya.
  7) Hatsa are now Hadza.
  8) Kwani is fictitious, they are now Kwandu.
  9) Lonwe are now Lomwe.
  10) Maleonde is fictitious, they are now Makonde.
  11) Tawana are now Tswana
  12) Yomba is the name of a North American Shoshone tribe. Yombe is the African tribe.
  13) Ngumi are now Nguni.
* Improved QOL by removing the up/down key bindings which increased/decreased the speed of purchasing goods and men on the expedition makeup sheet and reassigning them to LShift+left/right mouse button. This also applies to filling/emptying the canteen as well as publishing victory points.
* Fixed a bug which, after regaining the askaris' respect, caused them to start leaving the expedition if the explorer was instructed to stop doing bearer’s work. (If the expedition defeats a native tribe or kills a dangerous animal, respect is regained and the askaris should stop leaving, even if the explorer continues to remain a bearer.)
* Fixed a bug in the journal which caused the date text to become misaligned if the player managed to exceed more than 12 pages of discovery entries.
* Changed the journal font to match the calligraphy style to that of the map of Africa port names for the sake of consistency.
* Improved QOL by having the "overburdened" warning in the game panel display how many units of weight to dump.
* Bonuses such as "petroleum deposits", "strange geological formations", "geosynclines" and "strange crystal formations" are no longer found in lake hexes.
* If an attempt is made to exit a lake hex and the decision is made not to cache excess items and continue, the hex chosen as the exit point is now revealed and deemed to be "partially explored". This was done to fix an anomaly in the mini map which would reveal the hidden terrain in the exit point and display it as fully explored.

notes.title: R2.0.6d Bug fix
notes.content: * Fixed an anomaly in a line of code which could potentially crash the game if a missionary or doctor had to refuse the chief's gift of 5 askaris due to insufficient room in the canoe/s.

notes.title: R2.0.6c Minor changes and improvements
notes.content:
* To avoid losing too many supplies, the explorer will now automatically become a bearer if packmounts are being led and the last remaining bearer dies as the result of a disaster, becomes ill or is dismissed.
* The explorer automatically becomes a bearer if escaping native capture. Any askaris who have escaped with the explorer will not abandon him.
* The number of rations able to be carried while escaping from natives has been increased by 1 to take advantage of the fact that the explorer's musket does not count towards the portage cost.
* Ride mounts now take whatever supplies they are carrying with them, when the rider is discharged.

notes.title: R2.0.6b Bug fix
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug in the "bearer and 2 horses fall off the mountain" disaster that would incorrectly get rid of the explorer's horse and still show the expedition as being in mounted mode. This only occurred if there was just one bearer left to lead the pack mounts.
* Clarified some points in the downloadable manual.

notes.title: Update R2.0.6 Bug fix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug which prevented the expedition from hunting indefinitely if policy 1 was selected and the expedition continued to remain in the same hex as the natives. The policy 1 "message" would also be repeated even after the first turn penalty was served. Policy 1 would also still remain active if the explorer was captured and managed to escape.

notes.title: R2.0.5b Minor improvements
notes.content:
* Slightly buffed the kill shots in the "ten chimpanzees raid your camp" disaster to try and minimize the number of rations stolen. 
* Re-positioned the explorer title on the compendium cover so as to make it a "platform" for the two characters to stand on.

notes.title: R2.0.5 Bug fix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug in the mini map which did not revert partially explored hexes that had been fully explored and mapped during the current expedition, back to their original state if the explorer died.

notes.title: R2.0.4c Minor visual improvements
notes.content:
* Re-mastered the graphics on the attacked/ambushed pop-up.
* Fine-tuning of graphics on some bonus cards.

notes.title: R2.0.4b Bug fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug which would sometimes not make the explorer a bearer when escaping with pack mounts, resulting in the animals wandering off.
* Fixed a bug which displayed the message "insufficient bearers to carry out pelts" before the bonus card was displayed, if fur-bearing animals were discovered in veldt instead of mountain terrain.

notes.title: Update R2.0.4 Bug fix and visual improvements
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug which incorrectly retained some journal entries which should have been deleted due to the explorer's death. This only occurred if the game was saved and then reloaded prior to the explorer's demise.
* The hi-score table has been re-textured to match the pop-up boxes.
* Re-mastered the graphics on some bonus cards.

notes.title: R2.0.3c Crash fix and visual improvements
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash if the tsetse fly disaster was encountered. (This bug was introduced in build R2.0.3 due to an oversight in the "supplies lost" algorithm.)
* Re-mastered the graphics on some disaster cards.

notes.title: R2.0.3b Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug which registered a portage cost of zero if only one item remained.
* Changed the narrative of the "tribe becomes friendly, the chief poisons the witch doctor" bonus card, which defied logic with the fact that the explorer could still be poisoned by the dead witch doctor when initiating a trade.

notes.title: R2.0.3 Fixes and improvements
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug in the mini map which recorded the discovery of the Lost city as Dr.Livingstone and vice versa.
* Fixed a bug which prevented pack mounts from wandering off due to a lack of bearers to lead them, if the expedition was in mounted mode.
* Fixed a bug in the "2 horses and a bearer fall off a mountain path" which claimed one extra horse if the expedition was in mounted mode.
* The explorer's musket can no longer be lost due to disasters unless the expedition is travelling by canoe.
* Supplies will no longer be lost through horses and camels wandering off due to a shortage of bearers to lead them.
* Improved the "supplies lost" algorithm to give more accurate results.

notes.title: R2.0.2d Visual fixes
notes.content: * Fixed incorrect timber background textures of the crucifix and medicine bottle buttons used with the missionary and doctor.

notes.title: R2.0.2c Minor visual improvements
notes.content: * Improved the look of the message box border.

notes.title: R2.0.2b Small improvement
notes.content: * Graphically re-worked the main message box and gave it a lighter background to make it easier to read the text.

notes.title: Update R2.0.2 Important bug fix.
notes.content:
* Found and fixed a nasty bug which left remnant data of caches and natives from a previous saved game if the explorer died, or a new game was commenced. This only occurred if the player discovered very large numbers of individual tribes and/or built excessive numbers of caches. This would have the potential to cause issues with all new consecutive games. Selecting "new game" or waiting until the 3 lives expire with this new build will rectify any potential problems this bug may have caused/be causing.
* If the "new game" option was selected on the desk while the music box was opened, answering "no" would not recommence the music after the choice was made.

notes.title: R2.0.1 Improvements and minor fix
notes.content:
* Re-mastered the look of the cache screen for better clarity and to better match the graphics displayed on the cache token.
* Fixed a message box text alignment anomaly if plant specimens were selected to be taken from a cache.

notes.title: R2.0.0 New mini map feature, improvements and minor bug fixes.
notes.content:
Players' #1 request for a mini map has now been implemented. Unfortunately, due to software idiosyncrasies, this version is incompatible with any previous R1 saves.

* A map of the expedition's progress in Africa can now be accessed from the desk by selecting the map on the newspaper. Shown are terrain, rivers, lakes, oases and natives. Caches are not deemed to be "discoveries". Special discoveries are mentioned by name only, as their locations have no bearing on game play. 
* The journal can now also be accessed from the desk.
* The journal has been re-mastered and made larger to improve legibility.
* Re-mastered the look of the compendium pages for better clarity.
* Fixed a bug which incorrectly allowed men in the expedition not having to drink from their canteens while occupying a desert hex containing an oasis that is not a river source. Only animals have that privilege.
* Fixed a bug which confused spending a turn collecting fur or tusks with having to spend time with a native tribe, resulting in the output of an incorrect message.

notes.title: R1.1.1e Minor visual fixes and erratum.
notes.content:
* Fixed a visual anomaly in which the highlight glow of the music box and compendium would show through the opened instruction sheet if those objects underneath were moused over.
* The "New Game" button on the desk could be selected while another pop-up message was opened, resulting in the two boxes being overlayed.
* ERRATUM. A previous update R1.1.1 note stated that "The expedition will no longer consume canteen water supplies if in a hex containing an oasis." This should have read "Horses and camels will no longer consume canteen water supplies if in a hex containing an oasis."

notes.title: R1.1.1d Minor fix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug which did not register the carrying of bonus items if the expedition was forced to cache/discard portage after losing bearers to the "voodoo signs in jungle" disaster.

notes.title: R1.1.1c Minor fix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug which would re-enable muted drum sounds when quitting out of a native trade session.

notes.title: R1.1.1b update
notes.content:
* A message is now displayed if there are insufficient bearers to haul out pelts from the "fur-bearing animals" bonus.
* Fixed a bug which forced the player to spend a turn collecting pelts even if none could be collected due to a lack of bearers.
* Replaced the small, river flow direction tooltip with a much easier to read compass.

notes.title: Update R1.1.1 Improvements and fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug in the 4 crocodiles in/near the lake disaster which did not allow for the askari falling into the water, thereby incorrectly counting his shot as part of the volley.
* Dialogs now take into account whether the expedition is unarmed when trying to avert a disaster by shooting.
* Added a new witch doctor for desert tribes.
* Improved the text layout of the native trade screens for better clarity.
* Replaced the small yellow text tooltips with larger, easier to read cards which also include graphics.
* Fixed a bug which prevented water from being discarded if the explorer was ill.
* Friendly chief's offer of 5 askaris is now automatically rejected and the player alerted, if in canoe travel mode and there is insufficient room for even 1 askari in the canoes.
* A message now informs the player if a friendly chief offers askaris and there is a shortage of horses or camels while in mounted travel mode.
* Improved the native info and cache list displays for better clarity.
* Fixed a bug which displayed "There is no more water" message prior to the "killed by natives" screen if in desert areas and the expedition was killed by natives.
* Fixed a bug which prevented friendly natives supplying food to a sick explorer occupying the same hex.
* The expedition will no longer consume canteen water supplies if in a hex containing an oasis.
* Shortened the range at which caches start getting lost closer to ports to prevent too many lost caches.
* Fixed a bug which would incorrectly message that there weren't enough bearers to haul out tusks in the "discover large herd of elephants" bonus.
* Fixed a bug which forced the player to spend a turn collecting tusks even if none could be collected.
* Fixed a rare bug which could potentially interfere with the flow of a river.
* Fixed a bug which prevented the dumping of tusks if the expedition was in canoe mode, afflicted by a disaster and was forced to exit a river or lake without sufficient bearers to carry excess portage.

notes.title: update R1.1.0b
notes.content: *Changed the look of the native trade screen.

notes.title: update R1.1.0
notes.content: The player is now given a message whenever shots fired while trying to avert a disaster event have been unsuccessful.

notes.title: R1.0.9b
notes.content: Improved the look of the slave traders in the "Killed by slave traders" pop-up

notes.title: Update R1.0.9
notes.content:
* Added a new native attack pop-up as well as a new "Killed by hostile natives" for desert Bushmen tribes.
* Improved the faces of the natives in the generic "Killed by hostile natives" pop-up.
